item: The GET side-effects walk measures every request from a cold serving-window cache
summary: test_only_the_listed_routes_open_a_loopback_socket failed on #1848's shard 3 (run 42515630504): the qualification-assist self-test GET opened two loopback sockets. #1820 (260555116) had already pinned that self-test's serving window, but main did not carry it yet when that run started. The failure came and went because the serving-window cache (src.ai_layer.coverage, 300 s) decides whether sizing a prompt asks the model ports: an entry an earlier test in the same worker stored was still fresh when /api/diagnostics/all ran (its members used it and stored nothing) and had expired when the self-test's GET ran, which then probed. Reproduced on the pre-#1820 code with an entry given ten seconds to live at /api/diagnostics/all. Plain CPU load alone did not reproduce it: three loaded runs passed. Both walks now go through one step, _drive, which empties that cache before each request, so a GET that probes only on a miss fails on every run (the pre-#1820 self-test now fails the walk every time, and main passes). A new test fills the cache, drives a GET that probes on a miss, and needs the connect; a step without the emptying fails it. Release-notes line (R319): internal, users see no change.
